==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Armut''' was given to him by [[Achuu]], meaning "pear" in Turkish.
* Memed as ''The Most Handsome Player in the World''.
* His father, Tufan Tükek, a PhD in the Istanbul Faculty of Medicine, congratulated his son on Twitter by saying "Aferin İrfan" and this sentence became a meme in Turkey. 
** After Armut's [[2020 Season World Championship/Play-In|Worlds 2020 Play-In]] performance on September 26, "Aferin İrfan" was trending, with 2,000+ tweets.
* Famous for his looks into the camera whenever he notices it pointed at him during a game.
* Has 2 specific memes he created:
** "It's just my normal gameplay"
** "It's just Bao", which is shortening of the IRL name of his former teammate [[Japone]].
* Close friends with [[Bolulu]] , [[Japone]], and [[Closer (Can Çelik)|Closer]].
